title: Mechanic — complete skill frame set
source: maplestory.io, GMS version 270 (skillbook API; WZ API for 5th/6th-job paths/metadata)

skills.name: Mechanic Dash
skills.description: Double tap in any direction to dash. Can be used consecutively in mid-air.\n[Command: Right Arrow Right Arrow, or enter the skill button]

skills.name: Boosters online.
skills.description: Use the booster to hover in the air.

skills.name: Humanoid Mech
skills.description: Allows you to summon and mount a Humanoid Mech, which greatly increases your Speed, Attack Power, Defense, and the range of your downward jumps. When attacked, you cannot be knocked back.\nHit the skill key to mount/unmount.

skills.name: ME-07 Drillhands
skills.description: Uses drill arms to push and attack enemies. Can be resisted by some enemies.

skills.name: Gatling Gun
skills.description: Focuses your Gatling Gun on multiple enemies.

skills.name: Rocket Booster
skills.description: Use rocket power to jump. Upon landing, deal damage to enemies in range. This skill consumes MP both when you launch and when you land. Can also be used by pressing the up arrow key and attack key together. Permanently increases Movement Speed and Max Movement Speed.\nRight-click to lock the command.

skills.name: Mechanic Mastery
skills.description: Permanently increases your Attack Power, Weapon Mastery, Critical Rate, and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Perfect Armor
skills.description: Adds a new ability to your Mech.

skills.name: Physical Training
skills.description: Permanently increases STR and DEX through sheer physical training.

skills.name: Heavy Gatling Gun
skills.description: Focuses your Enhanced Gatling Gun on multiple enemies.

skills.name: Homing Beacon
skills.description:
Launches a Homing Beacon to attack multiple enemies. The beacon is programmed with multi-targeting to chase the targeted enemies.
Homing Beacons do not take damage from enemies' Attack Reflect skills, and target the boss with the highest HP first when used in tank mode.
oming Beacon can be fired continuously by holding down the key. You can move or use another skill while holding down the key for Homing Beacon.
Right-click to toggle the Homing Beacon smoke effect ON/OFF.

skills.name: Open Portal: GX-9
skills.description: Places Portal <GX-9>. Up to two portals can be opened at once, and party members can freely move between them. Will not work if the two portals are too far apart. The gates must be recharged after each use.\nRight-click to toggle the mode for party member use ON/OFF.

skills.name: Mechanic Rage
skills.description: Increases Attack Speed for a short time.

skills.name: Robo Launcher RM7
skills.description: Place a fixed artillery piece, the RM7, which fires multiple blasts straight forward, then self-destructs.\n<Robo Launcher RM7> does not take damage, even when attacking enemies with attack reflection.

skills.name: Overclock
skills.description: Significantly overclocks your Mech's servo-timing to provide a massive boost to Attack power.

skills.name: Advanced Homing Beacon
skills.description: Enhances Homing Beacon to increase Damage.

skills.name: Mechanized Defense System
skills.description: Enhances the Mech with unique Resistance skills, increasing survivability.

skills.name: Battle Program
skills.description: Increases Humanoid Mech Movement Speed, Attack Speed, and the battle efficiency of Rocket Booster and Mechanic Dash.

skills.name: Rock 'n Shock
skills.description: Place up to 3 <Rock 'n Shock> coils, which continuously attack and possibly stun enemies. They self-destruct when they run out of power.\nIf 0 coils are present and there is enough space to place 3 at once, you can place all 3 at once by using the down key.\nIf you place new coils while Rock 'n Shock is placed, the 3 previously placed coils are removed before placing them.

skills.name: Tank Mech
skills.description: Summons and mounts the Tank Mech.\nCan get on/off the mount by pressing the skill key. Press the skill key while mounted on the Humanoid Mech to convert to the Tank Mech.

skills.name: Heavy Salvo
skills.description: Fires off all Humanoid Mech ammo at once to scatter your attacks across multiple enemies. You can use this skill key in Tank mode to use its built-in weapons.

skills.name: AP Salvo
skills.description: Fires armor-piercing shells from the Tank Mech to land concentrated attacks on a small number of enemies. The armor-piercing shells target the boss with the highest HP first. You can use this skill key in Humanoid mode to use its built-in weapons.

skills.name: Support Unit: H-EX
skills.description: Summons H-EX, a stationary, multi-functional support robot. H-EX uses a special shockwave to reduce your enemy's Defense and recover HP for party members including yourself. Also increases all Elemental and Abnormal Status Resistances.

skills.name: Roll of the Dice
skills.description: Test your luck! Roll dice to get a random Buff. Roll a 1 and you get nothing, but Roll of the Dice cooldown will be reduced.

skills.name: Punch Launcher
skills.description: Launches fists to knock back multiple enemies. Can be resisted by some monsters.

skills.name: Extreme Mech
skills.description: Hop on your Humanoid Mech to increase Attack Power and Defense. Also increases Weapon Mastery.

skills.name: Robot Mastery
skills.description: Increase damage permanently, and increase the Attack Power, self-destruction damage, and summon duration of all summoned robots. This skill also increases the damage of <Robo Launcher RM7>. Using Custom Mode will not apply the skill effect transparency to robots where Robot Mastery is applied, except for Giant Robot SG-88 and Mecha Carrier.\nCustom Mode On/Off: Right-click

skills.name: Enhanced Support Unit
skills.description: Upgrades Support Unit.

skills.name: Double Down
skills.description: Try your luck! Roll two dice, and if both have the same number, you'll receive a very powerful buff.

skills.name: Homing Beacon Research
skills.description: Research Homing Beacon technology further to increase the number of missiles launched. Also improves the launch speed of Homing Beacon.

skills.name: Mech Alloy Research
skills.description: Permanently increases your Avoidability when hit while on the Mech. Decreases damage taken when you fail to dodge.

skills.name: Rock 'n Shock - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Rock 'n Shock damage.

skills.name: Rock 'n Shock - Persist
skills.description: Increases Rock 'n Shock duration.

skills.name: Rock 'n Shock - Guardbreak
skills.description: Increases Ignore Defense for Rock 'n Shock.

skills.name: Support Unit: H-EX - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the explosion damage for Support Unit: H-EX.

skills.name: Support Unit: H-EX - Party Reinforce
skills.description: Further increases Final Damage of party members from Support Unit: H-EX. Combines with the effect of Enhanced Support Unit.

skills.name: Support Unit: H-EX - Persist
skills.description: Increases Support Unit: H-EX duration.

skills.name: Heavy Salvo - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of Heavy and AP Salvo Plus. Does not apply to the second explosion of AP Salvo Plus and HEXA AP Salvo Plus.

skills.name: Heavy Salvo Plus - Spread
skills.description: Increases the max number of enemies hit by Heavy Salvo Plus. Does not apply to the second explosion of AP Salvo Plus and HEXA AP Salvo Plus.

skills.name: AP Salvo Plus - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases the number of attacks for AP Salvo Plus. Does not apply to the second explosion of AP Salvo Plus and HEXA AP Salvo Plus.

skills.name: Giant Robot SG-88
skills.description: Summons the giant robot SG-88 to bombard a group of enemies with missiles. An activation gauge pops up when this robot is summoned, and damage can be charged and amplified (up to double the base amount) by hitting the regular attack key. Invincible while using the skill. Not affected by effects which reset cooldown.

skills.name: Maple Warrior
skills.description: The Goddess of Maple World's grace increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Goddess of Maple World appear.

skills.name: Hero's Will
skills.description: Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.\nCan be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Bots 'n Tots
skills.description: Place a robot factory that summons toy robots. Summoned robots detect nearby enemies and self-destruct when near them. The factory itself also self-destructs after a short time. The factory cannot take damage, even when attacking enemies with attack reflection.

skills.name: Heavy Salvo Plus
skills.description: Fires off all Humanoid Mech ordnances at once to scatter your attacks across multiple enemies. You can use this skill key in Tank mode to use its built-in weapons.

skills.name: AP Salvo Plus
skills.description: Fires explosive armor-piercing shells from the Tank Mech to land concentrated attacks on a small number of enemies and trigger a second explosion. The explosive armor-piercing shells target the boss with the highest HP first. You can use this skill key in Humanoid mode to use built-in weapons.

skills.name: AP Salvo Plus
skills.description: Fires explosive armor-piercing shells from the Tank Mech to land concentrated attacks on a small number of enemies and trigger a second explosion.

skills.name: Distortion Bomb
skills.description: Detonates a special Resistance bomb to create a distortion field.\nThe field does not take damage even when attacking enemies with attack reflection.

skills.name: For Liberty
skills.description: Materializes the will of the Resistance to increase attack power.

skills.name: Full Spread
skills.description: Diverts power to the Homing Beacon rotation systems to expand the attack area.

skills.name: Doomsday Device
skills.description: Summons an diabolical death machine to annihilate your opponents. Unaffected by attack reflection.
skills.note: Has a projectile (ball) layer in the source data.

skills.name: Mobile Missile Battery
skills.description: Launches a missile battery that fires a barrage of micro-missiles. The micro-missiles target the boss with the highest HP first.

skills.name: Full Metal Barrage
skills.description: Use all available Mech weapons to fire every single one of your bullets at once. Invincible while casting, but cannot move or change direction.\nCan use a more powerful Homing Beacon while casting. Can also use buff skills that increase some stats after casting.

skills.name: Mecha Carrier
skills.description: Summon an aerial carrier, the pinnacle of Resistance technology. Carrier-based aircraft strafe nearby enemies, then return. The aircraft target the boss with the highest Max HP first.\nIf the aircraft stray too far from the Mechanic, they will move closer immediately. These aircraft are unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Full Metal Barrage
skills.description: Use all available Mech weapons to fire every single one of your bullets at once. Invincible while casting, but cannot move or change direction.\nCan use Homing Beacon while casting, can use multi-target, and there is no Final Damage reduction.

skills.name: HEXA Heavy Salvo Plus
skills.description: Fires off all Humanoid Mech ordnances at once to scatter your attacks across multiple enemies. You can use this skill key in Tank mode to use its built-in weapons.

skills.name: HEXA AP Salvo Plus
skills.description: Fires explosive armor-piercing shells from the Tank Mech to land concentrated attacks on a small number of enemies. The explosive armor-piercing shells target the farthest enemy within range, and the boss with the highest Max HP within range first. The explosive armor-piercing shells trigger a second explosion when the target is hit. You can use this skill key in Humanoid mode to use built-in weapons.
skills.note: Has a projectile (ball) layer in the source data.

skills.name: HEXA Homing Beacon
skills.description:
Launches a Homing Beacon to attack multiple enemies. The beacon is programmed to chase the targeted enemy.
Homing Beacons do not take damage from enemies' Attack Reflect skills, and target the boss with the highest HP first when used in tank mode.
oming Beacon can be fired continuously by holding down the key.
You can move or use another skill while holding down the key for Homing Beacon.
Right-click to toggle the Homing Beacon smoke effect ON/OFF.

skills.name: HEXA Distortion Bomb
skills.description:
Detonates a special Resistance bomb to create a distortion field. Periodically enhances with Intense Distortion Bomb to completely distort the surrounding area.
The field does not take damage even when attacking enemies with attack reflection.
Warp effect is applied in the distortion field when the skill is used, and the intensity of the effect is affected by the skill effect transparency.
Warp Effect Lock: Right-click

skills.name: Intense Distortion Bomb
skills.description: A special bomb creates a distortion field to completely distort the surrounding area.\nWarp effect is applied in the distortion field when the skill is used, and the intensity of the effect is affected by the skill effect transparency.\nWarp Effect Lock: Right-click

skills.name: HEXA Robo Launcher RM7
skills.description: Places a fixed artillery piece, the RM7, which fires multiple blasts straight forward, then self-destructs.\nIncreases Summon Duration.\nRobo Launcher RM7 does not take damage, even when attacking enemies with attack reflection.

skills.name: HEXA Rock 'n Shock
skills.description:
Places up to 3 Rock 'n Shock coils, which continuously attack and possibly stun enemies. They self-destruct when they run out of power.
If 0 coils are present and there is enough space to place 3 at once, you can place all 3 at once by using the down key.
If you place new coils while Rock 'n Shock is placed, the 3 previously placed coils are removed before placing them.
Also permanently enhances HEXA AP Salvo Plus's 2nd explosive attack.
Increases Summon Duration.
skills.note: Has a projectile (ball) layer in the source data.

skills.name: HEXA Bots 'n Tots
skills.description: Places a robot factory that summons toy robots. Summoned robots detect nearby enemies and self-destruct when near them. The factory itself also self-destructs after a short time.\nIncreases Summon Duration.\nThe factory cannot take damage, even when attacking enemies with attack reflection.

skills.name: Robo Conversion: CB-P1
skills.description: Summons a nodebot integrated with prototype technology. While Robo Conversion: CB-P1 is active, HEXA Robo Launcher RM7, HEXA Rock 'n Shock, HEXA Bots 'n Tots RM1 VI will attach to the nodebot when summoned, and the skills will be unavailable.\nCan be toggled On/Off.

skills.name: Ground Zero
skills.description:
Unleashes a large-scale missile system maintained by the Resistance to completely obliterate the target.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +20%
Lv. 20 - Boss Damage: +20%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +30%, Boss Damage: +30%

skills.name: Ground Zero
skills.description: Unleashes a large-scale missile system maintained by the Resistance to completely obliterate the target.

skills.name: Mechanized Extinction
skills.description:
Summons a massive mech built from the Resistance's latest technology to exterminate everything on the battlefield.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 20 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +20%
